name: xcode-skills
description: Xcode IDE integration with native MCP tools and Apple-provided skills for SwiftUI, UIKit, App Intents, accessibility, localization, testing, and security.

interface.shortDescription: Apple platform skills for development, accessibility audits, translation, testing, and security.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that integrates with the Xcode IDE through its native MCP tools and Apple-provided skills. Covers SwiftUI, UIKit, App Intents, document-based apps, Swift Testing, device verification, C bounds safety, security audits, Dynamic Type, contrast, VoiceOver, and String Catalog translation with language-specific style guides.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Xcode project security settings.
Review this SwiftUI code for modern best practices.
Modernize this UIKit app for scene-based lifecycle.
Review these App Intents for correctness and modern APIs.
Audit my views for Dynamic Type, contrast, and VoiceOver support.
Translate my Xcode String Catalogs into another language.
